notes.title: Update on May 18
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug that allowed players to jump onto turrets.

Greatly increased turret range, especially for low-level turrets.

Changed the status menu text color from black to white to ensure contrast with the background.

notes.title: Update on May 17
notes.notes:
Update Notes:

If you wish to play multiplayer, please ensure that all players have updated to the latest version.

Fixed a bug where max-level turrets could still be upgraded, which caused their damage to become ineffective.

Fixed a bug in single-player mode where Dingzhen could be instantly killed.

Fixed a bug where the Lightning Five-Whip did not deal area damage.

Greatly increased the damage of the Lightning Five-Whip.
